settings.title: What Is Ring-Spun Cotton?
settings.dek: Twisted and thinned as it's spun — softer, smoother, stronger than open-end cotton, and it holds fine print detail.

settings.title: What Is a Triblend Shirt?
settings.dek: Three fibers — poly, cotton, rayon — for a soft, lightweight tee with vintage drape and a heathered look.

settings.title: What Is Combed Cotton?
settings.dek: Combed to pull out the short, weak fibers before spinning — smoother, softer, stronger cotton that prints clean.

settings.title: What Is a Raglan Sleeve?
settings.dek: The diagonal seam from underarm to collar — no shoulder seam — behind baseball tees and raglan sweatshirts.

settings.title: Fleece vs French Terry
settings.dek: Brushed fuzzy pile runs warm; unbrushed loops run light. How the two hoodie fabrics compare.

settings.title: What Is Garment-Dyed?
settings.dek: Sewn first, then dyed as a finished piece — for a soft, broken-in feel and a lived-in, faded color.

settings.title: Cotton vs Polyester vs Blend
settings.dek: Which t-shirt fabric to print on: cotton holds detail, polyester sublimates, blends do both. The fabric decides the method.

settings.title: What Is Piqué Fabric?
settings.dek: The raised, waffle-textured knit behind classic polos — breathable, structured, and built to grip embroidery. Cotton, poly, or blend.

settings.title: What Is HTV (Heat-Transfer Vinyl)?
settings.dek: Cut-and-press vinyl that bonds to a shirt with heat — opaque, so it covers darks, and the easiest method for small custom runs.

settings.title: What Is a Crew Neck?
settings.dek: The round, collarless neckline at the base of the neck — the print-ready default on tees and sweatshirts, named for rowing crews.

settings.title: What Is Puff Print?
settings.dek: The raised, 3D ink effect — a heat-expanding additive that puffs the print into a soft foam texture. Bold shapes, best on cotton.

settings.title: What Is Jersey Knit?
settings.dek: The soft, stretchy single knit most t-shirts are made from — smooth front, looped back. A structure, not a fiber, and the easiest face to print.

settings.title: What Is Heather Fabric?
settings.dek: The soft, flecked look you see on gray tees — different-colored fibers blended into the yarn before spinning. A coloring technique, not a fiber.
